Precise environment outpainting extending the provided reference image into a full 16:9 canvas. The reference image contains an ancient dark fantasy arena surrounded by flat grey border margins on all four sides. Seamlessly fill and replace all grey margins by continuing the existing painted environment outward to the edges of the 16:9 frame:
- The central arena must remain intact, identical in scale, perspective, and position: dark verdigris-green weathered stone flagstone ground, intricate cracks, bronze/copper glowing astrological circles and crescent moon markings, and exactly five ancient standing stone monolith pylons carved with concentric circle runes.
- Keep all five pylons intact; do not duplicate them or add new pylons in the outer margins.
- Extend the dark greenish-grey verdigris cracked stone floor naturally and seamlessly across the left, right, and bottom margins.
- Extend the ancient crumbling masonry stone wall and dark atmospheric background seamlessly across the top margin.
- Perfect seamless blending across the previous grey boundaries with zero seams, zero lines, and absolutely no remaining grey bands, borders, or frames.
- Stylized hand-painted dark fantasy digital painting aesthetic, isometric 55-degree high-angle oblique camera view, moody ambient lighting. No characters, no figures, no monsters, no weapons, no text, no UI.
